CS 310 — Data Structures and Algorithms
Fall 2026

Instructor: Dr. Elena Chen
Email: echen@university.edu
Office Hours: Tue 2:00-4:00 PM, Room 214

Course Description

This course covers fundamental data structures and the algorithms that operate on
them. Students will implement, analyse and compare structures including arrays,
linked lists, hash tables, balanced trees and graphs. Prerequisites: CS 210.
3 credit hours.

Tentative Course Schedule

Week 1 (Aug 25 - Aug 29): Course introduction, complexity analysis. Reading: Ch. 1
Week 2 (Sep 1 - Sep 5): Arrays and linked lists. Reading: Ch. 2
Week 3 (Sep 8 - Sep 12): Stacks, queues and recursion. Reading: Ch. 3
Week 4 (Sep 15 - Sep 19): Hash tables. Reading: Ch. 4
Week 5 (Sep 22 - Sep 26): Trees and traversal. Reading: Ch. 5
Week 6 (Sep 29 - Oct 3): Balanced trees. Reading: Ch. 6
Week 7 (Oct 6 - Oct 10): Heaps and priority queues. Reading: Ch. 7
Week 8 (Oct 13 - Oct 17): Graphs. Reading: Ch. 8
Week 9 (Oct 20 - Oct 24): Shortest paths. Reading: Ch. 9
